ra: The Hat Man is a core recurring figure of the supernatural-assault / sleep-paralysis tradition.
Shadow People are a recurring figure of the sleep-paralysis assault tradition.
The Old Hag is Hufford's paradigm case of the experience-centered sleep-paralysis tradition.
The chest-pressing night-hag/strangler complex continues the older Lilith-as-nocturnal-strangler / mara night-mare tradition.
Sleep-paralysis experiencers invoke prayer and guardian angels to ward off the pressing Hag.
Experiencers commonly invoke guardian-angel protection and prayer against Shadow People.
The Mantis and the machine elves are the two best-documented recurrent DMT entity-types, both encountered in the same entheogenic visionary space.
Mothman is a paradigmatic modern cryptid of the sighting-wave tradition.
The Chupacabra is a core modern cryptid of vernacular belief.
The Jersey Devil is a durable regional modern cryptid.
Mothman is read as a harbinger of catastrophe (the Silver Bridge collapse), embodying disaster-omen / eschatological dread.
El Cucuy/the Boogeyman is the archetypal apotropaic child-warding bogey.
The Black-Eyed Children are engaged through the apotropaic 'don't let them in' threshold rule.
La Llorona is warded against (prayer, keeping children from water) within a Catholic folk frame invoking angelic/saintly protection.
La Llorona functions as an apotropaic child-warning figure alongside the bogey complex.
Krampus is the punishing companion of St. Nicholas in the Alpine Nicholas–Krampus winter custom (Krampusnacht).
St. Nicholas rewards good children while restraining/pairing with Krampus who punishes the bad — a protector-vs-menace dyad in the living custom.
Ouija practitioners ward off Zozo with prayer, board-closing protocols, and appeals to angelic protection.
Bloody Mary and Zozo are both deliberately summoned/contacted entities of adolescent ritual-conjuration legendry.
Slender Man is the leading online-born ostensive being, sharing the sighting/menace mode with the modern cryptid cluster.
Tulpas and DMT entities are both relational, agentic mind-encountered beings people engage as autonomous interlocutors.
Roko's Basilisk and Slender Man are both digital-age egregores born online that some people genuinely act on (dread/avoidance).
